requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Gender on the caption line - the box for male

requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: mark ONE of the three gender boxes on the caption line: male, female or other. This one is male

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Docket No.: in the caption at the head of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Docket No.: in the caption at the head of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no docket number for any juvenile matter, and the shared binder additionally reads a bare "Docket No." caption as a repeating charge-row label demanding an indexed fact this one-case petition does not have
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the docket number of the juvenile case you want sealed, from the court's own file or from the paperwork you were given

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Location (Town): in the caption at the head of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Location (Town): in the caption at the head of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no committed record this family binds establishes the court location for any particular Maine juvenile case, and the route-obligation census records this route's destination as "not recorded"
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the town in which the Juvenile Court that handled your case sits, as the caption of your own case names it. Ask a court clerk if you are not sure

protectedBlanks.label: Date (mm/dd/yyyy) beside the juvenile's signature
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the petition is signed would be false; the field is also declared unwritable by role, which the finalizer checks before any name or caption match

protectedBlanks.label: Signature of Juvenile - the widget the Judicial Branch leaves unnamed, captioned "Signature of Juvenile" printed directly beneath it
protectedBlanks.why: the juvenile signs the petition personally and this build never signs for anyone; the field is also declared unwritable by role, so no rename and no caption change can reach it
